verificationMethod: Each signature below was resolved via https://api.devnet.solana.com (getTransaction + getSignaturesForAddress). Every one invoked this program and committed successfully (meta.err === null). The postRecoveryState block was re-decoded from the live vault account using this repository's IDL.

deployedBuild.verification: The ELF embedded in the upgradeable ProgramData account (offset 45, length 476264) hashes to this sha256, identical to target/deploy/sentinel.so in this repository. Note: `solana program dump` reports 544000 bytes here because a ProgramData account cannot shrink after a smaller upgrade, so it returns the trailing stale bytes.
hardeningShipped: check_pyth_slot_lag: binds each consumed Pyth price update to its posting slot (<=64 slots), closing stale-print replay
recover() oversell guard gated on an actual breach, fixing a recovery state no sell_units could satisfy
sync_vault requires an active policy (ledger cannot be rewritten mid-recovery)
initialize_policy AND update_policy both reject degenerate configurations that would disable the guardrails
deployedBuild.note: The lifecycle transactions below predate this upgrade. The quarantine/containment state machine is unchanged between builds, so they remain valid proof of the state machine, but not of the three hardening changes above.
